_about: 古七's boards (h11; the per-回 plan 2026-10-15, Wave 2 D): each the book's own action where its scene stands, every one skippable once stuck (the page's 算了，往下走), and each pays what the plan names — 修为 for cultivation (禹步, 定风), 灵石 / a thing for the rest (认方 a 聚气丹, 闻焦 and 芦苇 灵石). The two fights (灵草谷's 犰狳, 崖顶's 秦雁) are scene duels on their exits, paid there.
_economy: Pay declared here for the economy model (tools/balance.mjs reads tasks/*.json): the 修为 is +10 over 古七 from boards (jiuge-yubu 5, furnace-ding 5; 随叶 and 顺风溜's 5 each went with the 调息 cut 2026-10-20, told), +30 the 犰狳 (09-lingcao/fight, scene table) and +30 the 秦雁 bout (09-futian/spar, trial table, paid after the 七层 rise); 灵石 +2 (yishui-reed; year-smell's +3 went with its cut 2026-10-19), +20 (犰狳), +20 (秦雁); items: qi-pill (furnace-recipe), huochai-jian and shunfeng-liu (on the ways on). The three rises — 五层 (09-furnace/fire, and 09-year/futian as a catch-up), 六层 (09-yishui/night), 七层 (09-futian/spar, the 秦雁 bout's way on) — each wait on the 阶段任务: 圆满 of the layer held (caps.hui.h11.gates: [{layer 4, 09-furnace, [fire]}, {layer 4, 09-year, [futian]}, {layer 5, 09-yishui, [night]}, {layer 6, 09-futian, [spar]}]).

tasks._was: 禹步 · 九格 (games/yubujiuge.js, home-made: 左脚 · 右脚绕 · the next square) until 2026-10-27, deleted; the classic Simon (照着走) plays the same lesson — 瞿老 walks the nine squares, you follow his feet. Id, pay and marks kept, so a save holding it done or offered goes on as it was.

zh.ready: 「九格你摆得出来，走却是另一回事。」瞿老道，「照着我的脚，走一遍。」
zh.show: 瞿老走在前头。看他的脚。
zh.trip: 右脚绕过左脚的时候，自己绊了自己一下。瞿老再走一遍。
zh.quiet: 他走完九格，站在中宫，一点声息也没有。瞿老背对着他道：「猎户的脚。」
zh.loudly: 他走完了九格，站在中宫。瞿老扫着青石上的雪末子，道：「再走。脚落下去，先落脚尖。」
zh.skipped: 瞿老走完九格，站在中宫，道：「这叫禹步。」

en.ready: "Laying out the nine squares is one thing; walking them is another," said Elder Qu. "Follow my feet. Walk it once."
en.show: Elder Qu walks ahead. Watch his feet.
en.trip: As his right foot went round the left, he tripped himself. Elder Qu walks it again.
en.quiet: He walked all nine squares and stood in the centre palace without a sound. With his back to him, Elder Qu said, "A hunter's feet."
en.loudly: He walked all nine and stood in the centre palace. Elder Qu, sweeping the snow off the bluestone, said, "Again. When the foot comes down, toes first."
en.skipped: Elder Qu walked the nine squares and stood in the centre palace. "This is called the Step of Yu."
